name: Mogao Caves
description: Carved into a desert cliff about 25 km southeast of Dunhuang in Gansu province, the Mogao Caves are a honeycomb of nearly 500 painted and sculpted Buddhist temples. Monks began digging them in 366 CE, and work continued for roughly a thousand years along the Silk Road. Inside, you'll find walls covered in murals and rows of statues, plus the sealed "Library Cave" that held a hoard of ancient manuscripts.
